mapper.sql: id, code, name, resource_type, parent_id, path, http_method, icon, status, is_builtin, sort, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE status <> 2 ORDER BY parent_id, sort, id
SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 2
SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 2 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE code = #{code} AND status <> 2

SELECT FROM sys_permission WHERE status = 1 AND code IN
#{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (code, name, resource_type, parent_id, path, http_method, icon, status, is_builtin, sort, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{resourceType}, #{parentId}, #{path}, #{httpMethod}, #{icon}, #{status}, #{isBuiltin}, #{sort}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET name = #{name}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, parent_id = #{parentId}, path = #{path}, http_method = #{httpMethod}, icon = #{icon}, status = #{status}, sort = #{sort}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 2
